Subject: Renewal prep: attestation evidence checklist + capacity uplift proposal

Hi James / Maria —

As we approach your renewal window next month I wanted to surface two items that will affect the contract amendment and timeline: (1) SOC attestation / evidence for recertification, and (2) the capacity uplift you mentioned on last week’s call.

Quick summary / asks: 
- Term: you signaled interest in moving from a 12->24 month term. We can offer a 10% prepay discount on Dedicated capacity if you commit to 24 months.
- Attestation: Nimbus requested the latest SOC evidence and a clarified log-retention posture. Please confirm whether the audit scope needs the prior 12 months or if you need extended retention (15–18 months). We can support both, but extended retention has a storage and export cost.
- Capacity: per your growth forecast, we sketched a 2x Dedicated GPU pool uplift (N1 -> N2). I’ve attached a rough cost delta.

Attached: high-level SOC evidence bundle manifest (redacted), a small sample of audit logs, and a one-page cost delta for retention + capacity.

Next steps I propose: 
1) You confirm desired log-retention window (12 vs 18 months) by 2026-11-10.
2) If you want 24-month term + capacity uplift, I’ll generate an amendment and a prepay quote for procurement.
3) We’ll schedule an evidence handoff call to walk through the SOC artifacts (30 min).

If helpful I can also pull a short extract of SIEM events and anonymize principal IDs ahead of your audit team.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0127

- Cost: Can you share a ballpark incremental monthly cost for 18 months retention + the 2x Dedicated pool? Maria is looping procurement to understand OPEX vs. CAPEX.

James —

We can support 18-month immutable retention. A few technical notes and the cost approach: 
- Implementation: store compressed write-once copies of HTTP access logs and K/V operational logs to cold storage (encrypted, HSM-backed keys). We keep a 30-day hot window for fast retrieval and an 18-month cold bucket for exports.
- Export & evidence: we’ll provide a monthly CSV extract and the SIEM digest for the audit team. See attached sample (audit-logs-sample.csv).
- Cost delta: the attached spreadsheet (retention-cost-breakdown.xlsx) shows an estimated $1,800/month incremental for 18-month retention at your current volume (~1.2 TB/month), plus $6,400/month for the Dedicated pool uplift (2x capacity). One-time data-migration fee: $1,200.
- SLA: note that extended retention increases our data-availability obligations. For the amendment we recommend an SLA addendum that clarifies retrieval SLAs for cold exports (24–72 hours).

If procurement wants a lower OPEX profile we can do staged retention (12 months hot + additional 6 months cold-on-request) to cut the monthly delta ~45%.

-Karthik
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai

Attachments: audit-logs-sample.csv, retention-cost-breakdown.xlsx

Aditya / Karthik —

Procurement here. A couple of items we need to close on before we can route to PO: 
1) Final quote with line items (retention, capacity uplift, migration). Please include term options (12mo vs 24mo) and the prepay discount for 24mo.
2) Our legal team will provide a redline. We need confirmation Redwood can include a data residency clause limiting processing to US-only regions.
3) Can you confirm whether the amendment requires an SLA exception for extended retention costs/credits? Our security team will not accept longer retrieval SLAs without a credit schedule.

Please send the final amendment and a draft PO template; we aim to approve cost by 2026-11-18 to meet our procurement cycle.

Thanks,
